conceptZh: 科學家老鼠滾出一顆紅豆，紅豆在畫面裡彈來彈去，每撞一下就掉下一筆，湊成「糸」加「工」，組成「紅」字。
object: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse, a bouncing glossy red bean, and test tubes that ring when hit
morph: a red bean ricochets around and each hit drops one stroke of 糸 and 工 into place to form 紅
creativeAngle: 連鎖彈跳：一顆紅豆在試管與燒杯之間彈來彈去，每次撞擊掉一筆，先「糸」再「工」，老鼠的眼鏡跟著追蹤紅豆。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and clear, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-mint backdrop with a few ringing glass test tubes standing at the bottom left and right. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated vermilion-red Traditional Chinese glyph 紅, the silk component 糸 on the left and the beam 工 on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat with round glasses and a curled tail; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the mouse holds up a beaker, tips it and a single glossy red bean rolls out; the first spoken 紅 lands as the bean pings off the rim of a test tube, which rings with a bright note, and drops the first red stroke, a small twist of thread curling in at the left. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the bean rockets across the frame, ricochets from a test tube to a beaker to the ceiling, and each hit drops another stroke, the second twist, then the lower flick and three tiny dots of the 糸 stacking into place at left, while the mouse's glasses swing left and right as he tracks it, his head spinning; the second spoken 紅 lands as the left half completes. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the bean ricochets one last time off the mouse's tail, bounces off his round glasses, and thuds into the right side where two last strokes drop in as the horizontal bars and the upright of 工; the word 紅豆 is spoken as the bean rolls to the mouse's paws, and glows with a happy sparkle while the mouse catches it. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 紅 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in vermilion; the mouse sits at the side holding the shiny bean, hugging it with a tail wiggle and polishing his glasses, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「紅、紅、紅豆」, read as ㄏㄨㄥˊ、ㄏㄨㄥˊ、ㄏㄨㄥˊ ㄉㄡˋ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.8s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. No background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.

conceptZh: 披風英雄想飛過去撞倒一排紅色線軸和紅色橫樑保齡球瓶，結果披風蓋住頭、絆倒後用肚子滑過去，「砰」地把整排撞飛，線軸堆成「糸」、橫樑疊成「工」，組成「紅」，布忍者的煙霧彈還噴出一大團紅色煙。
object: a row of glossy red bowling-pin props: curly spools of red thread and short red beams, with a tiny felt ninja badly hiding behind the last one
morph: the caped hero belly-slides into the row; the thread spools tumble and stack into the silk component 糸 on the left, the beams fall into the horizontal bars and upright of 工 on the right, forming 紅
creativeAngle: 改走肚皮滑行保齡球式撞擊：披風太長蓋住頭是跌倒的原因，也是笑點；紅色線軸對應「糸」、紅色橫樑對應「工」，撞擊本身讓零件落成字形。布忍者只在最後當被撞飛的「球瓶」和噴紅煙的配角，不碰筆畫。上一版用紅豆彈跳慢慢掉筆畫，這版是一次大撞擊，節奏更快。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated slapstick clip, locked frontal camera, bright soft lighting, no flashing. Setting: a clean pale-cream glossy floor that fades into a plain light-butter backdrop, nothing busy behind. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated vermilion-red Traditional Chinese glyph 紅, silk component 糸 on the left and beam 工 on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original caped action-figure hero: chunky plastic limbs, a big confident chin, and a shiny red cape three sizes too long that keeps flopping over his head. No real people.

Moment one (0.0-1.6s): the hero stands at far left, plants his fists on his hips and points dramatically at a row of glossy red bowling-pin props standing at the right: curly spools of red thread and short red beams, with a tiny felt ninja badly hiding behind the last pin, his pointy ears sticking out. The first spoken 紅 lands as the hero points at the red row and the pins glint.

Moment two (1.6-3.2s): the hero leaps to fly, the long cape flops straight over his face, he flails blind, runs in a wobbly line, trips on the cape hem and dives belly-first, skidding across the slippery floor like a bowling ball with the cape streaming behind him, eyes wide, mouth a round O.

Moment three (3.2-4.6s): BONK. He plows into the row with cartoon squash-and-stretch. Pins fly up spinning: two curly spools land stacked as the twisting top loops of 糸, a hooked spool drops under them, two tiny bobbins plop beside it as the small dots. Two beams clap down as the top and bottom bars of 工 and a third stands up between them as the upright. The second spoken 紅 lands exactly as the last beam thunks into place and the whole glyph 紅 snaps crisp and vermilion. The felt ninja is launched sideways and lands upside-down at the far right corner.

Moment four (4.6-5.2s): the hero pops up at the far left in a strike pose, cape finally hanging straight. The ninja's smoke bomb goes off late with a soft poof, blooming a big round red cloud that dusts the ninja head to toe in red. The word 紅色 is spoken exactly as the red cloud blooms.

From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 紅 stays perfectly still, unobstructed and readable. Off to the sides, the hero does a tiny victory wiggle and the cape flops over his head once more while the red-dusted ninja gives a thumbs-up; neither ever touches or covers the strokes.

Narration, off-screen only, warm friendly Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua: the voice says exactly 「紅、紅、紅色」, read as ㄏㄨㄥˊ、ㄏㄨㄥˊ、ㄏㄨㄥˊ ㄙㄜˋ, first utterance at about 0.7s, second at about 3.9s, the word at about 4.8s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. No background music, only soft cartoon slide and bonk sounds quieter than the voice. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
